headerDisplay: Apple TV (pyatv) Power & Siri Remote Bridge for HomeKit and Target Devices
footerDisplay: Pair once on your Homebridge host via: atvremote -s <APPLE_TV_IP> --protocol companion pair

name.title: Apple TV Name
name.description: Name of the Apple TV Power Switch exposed in Apple Home (for grouping/automating your target device power).

pythonPath.title: Python 3 Path
pythonPath.description: Path to python3 executable where pyatv is installed (e.g. 'python3' or '/opt/homebrew/bin/python3').

companionCredentials.title: Companion Credentials (from atvremote pair)
companionCredentials.description: Obtain by running: atvremote -s <APPLE_TV_IP> --protocol companion pair

airplayCredentials.title: AirPlay Credentials (optional)
airplayCredentials.description: Obtain by running: atvremote -s <APPLE_TV_IP> --protocol airplay pair

exposePlaybackSensor.title: Expose Playback Motion Sensor (for Lighting Scenes)
exposePlaybackSensor.description: Exposes a Motion Sensor that activates whenever the Apple TV is playing media.

targetHost.title: Target Device IP Address (Direct Volume/Power Target)
targetHost.description: Optional: Directly forwards Siri Remote Volume Up/Down and source-aware Power On/Off to your target device over TCP.

targetStepDb.title: Volume Step per Button Press (dB)
targetStepDb.description: How many dB to step the target device volume on each Siri Remote Volume Up/Down press.

targetAppleTvProfileId.title: Target Device Profile/Input ID for Apple TV
targetAppleTvProfileId.description: When Apple TV powers on, switches the target device to this Profile/Input ID. When Apple TV sleeps, ONLY powers off the target device if it is still on this Profile/Input ID.

targetSyncPowerOn.title: Wake Target Device when Apple TV Wakes

targetSyncPowerOff.title: Power Off Target Device when Apple TV Sleeps (Source-Aware)
